A vault only you control. Stop checking in, and your assets go to the address you chose.

How vault recovery works

Protected. Your vault holds the assets. You check in on a schedule you set.

The guarantees

## What stays true, however you set it up

*   “Who actually holds my assets?”

### Your Safe, your assets

Your assets sit in a Safe contract you alone own. The people you involve in the handoff don't co-own your Safe. [What guardians can't do](https://app.ante.org/vaults/help/concepts/guardians#what-guardians-cannot-do) 
*   “What if I forget to check in?”

### A window you can close

A handoff doesn't fire the moment you go quiet. During the handoff grace period, any check-in from you cancels the handoff. [The handoff timeline](https://app.ante.org/vaults/help/concepts/timeline) 
*   “What if Ante disappears?”

### The Recovery Kit

A document that shows you exactly how to operate your vault directly onchain, even without the Ante app. 
*   “What if someone forces me?”

### Guardians can't redirect

A handoff can only ever send assets to the recipient you already named — a guardian, pressured or not, can't point it anywhere else. 

Your setup

## Choose who guards your assets, and who gets them if you don’t check in.

Protected. Your vault holds the assets. You check in on a schedule you set.

Your phone can die without taking your crypto with it. But lose this device and your recovery address, and not even Ante can help.

*   Losing this device: covered
*   You, out of reach: not covered at this setting
*   Handing it down: not covered at this setting
*   A helper going rogue: covered

Lost ETH: Conor Grogan, Coinbase (2025), a conservative count that excludes forgotten keys and dormant wallets. Family-access figure: DGLegacy holder survey. Six months is Ante’s default check-in interval, and you can change it.

Unlike classic social recovery, Ante guardians cannot move your assets anywhere else. Even a colluding majority can only send them to the address you chose.

Vitalik’s first suggested guardian is a device you already own.

Live on mainnet

## Proof, not promises

A public vault that runs a real handoff on mainnet, on a loop. Watch one end to end.

[Watch the handoff loop](https://app.ante.org/vaults/loop)

## Back it up today. Hand it down someday.

Two minutes, one address you control. Change who holds the roles anytime.
